Milestone 4 quarto website
text: This page uses real public FRED data from the last five years and builds an interactive view of how AI, robotics, and automation pressure may relate to unemployment and labor-market displacement. The chart expands the monthly payroll and unemployment records into thousands of observation rows across sector and occupation risk groups.

text:
Social media can serve both as a communication channel and a distraction. A simple productivity view reports the following sample indicators:








Metric
Value
Interpretation




Daily social media use
42 min
Moderate use may support learning and community, but time intensity matters.


Group attention loss
15%
Users often lose focus after a short scroll session.


Task completion impact
18%
Work sessions with frequent social-media check-ins may finish more slowly.


Productive platform use
67%
When used for audience research, learning, and professional networking, social media can support job productivity.



Productivity improves when social-media use is planned, limited, and tied to a clear work goal rather than treated as a constant background channel.
